verdict.rationale: The only settlement-related evidence is that MoonPay's quote endpoints return a locked rate with fees and limits per transaction (moonpay-docs-14, moonpay-docs-36), and webhooks notify on account activity (moonpay-docs-11). A community member had to dig to find a fee chart (moonpay-comm-2), so fees are visible per quote but not clearly published per rail. Missing for 10: documented timing from payment to available balance, a published per-rail fee schedule, and statements or reconciliation reports consumable by accounting.
